model.title: Reversionary Interest Conveyance Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Doris Matsui (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Bureau of Land Management to sell the federal government's reversionary interest in approximately 8.43 acres of land in Sacramento, California, to the current landowner. The landowner would need to pay at least the fair market value of that interest plus all costs associated with the sale, with proceeds going into a federal account for land disposal.
